summary: Short edge of a busy arterial beside hatched markings, no parking.
reasons: Main road, no cars parked along kerb
Narrow dirt verge beside live lane
House about 15 m from the stretch

drivers.seclusion: Open to the road and a detached house 15 m away; commercial buildings on either side.
drivers.access_and_room: Ten metres of road edge by a hatched island; the verge is narrow and sits at the lane, so a van would stay partly in traffic.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane arterial with buses and trucks.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along this edge; cars only appear in the shop strip further east.

sun_shade: Tree canopy to the south-west side; open from the north.
